The tolerances come from the 'oracle_settings' of each input (which in this batch all reference 's0', which has atol=1e-06 and rtol=null, meaning it will use the default from TOLERANCE_DICT in the helper code).

Therefore, the extra checks (sparse and gradient) are not executed for this batch.

Thus, for the given batch of inputs (37-47), the Test Code only runs the `value_test` with `test_dtypes=True`, which covers the dtype, shape, and value checks as described in the TDL.
